title: PolicyAction
description: A response step that the enforcement point carries out when a PolicyRule or Condition matches, such as blocking, redirecting, challenging, masking, quarantining, or notifying. It is parameterised by a type and its configuration, and corresponds to an obligation or advice attached to a policy decision rather than to the decision itself. Use PolicyRule instead when the element is the condition-plus-effect unit that yields the permit/deny decision, not the side-effect or response carried out after the decision. Use Countermeasure instead when the element is a standing control or mitigation assessed against a threat, with effectiveness and implementation status, rather than a per-match runtime response. Use AuditConfig instead when the element configures which events are logged and at what verbosity system-wide, rather than a single 'log' or 'alert' step fired by a rule match. Use FieldAccessControl instead when masking or redaction is declared statically for a named data field, independent of any policy rule firing.

type.description: Enforcement action type applied when the parent policy rule fires.

parameters.description: Key-value configuration for the action (e.g., redirect URL, notification recipient, masking pattern).

x-dr-standard: XACML 3.0 §5.39–5.40 ObligationExpression/AdviceExpression (enforcement per NIST SP 800-53 AC-3)
x-dr-evidence: A WAF or gateway rule config whose action field is set to a verb such as block, captcha, challenge, redirect, or count (e.g. AWS WAF Action, Cloudflare firewall action, Envoy RBAC action).
A policy-decision handler that switches on the decision or obligation ID and dispatches to a 403 response, a step-up MFA challenge, a redirect, or a notification sender.
An OPA/Rego or Cedar policy output that returns obligations or advice objects alongside allow/deny (e.g. {"action":"notify","recipient":...}), consumed by enforcement middleware.
